VAR_OperationMode.description: Stores the current DMP COMMAND operation mode.

GET_DMP_Command_Configuration.description: Loads all active DMP COMMAND configuration rows in one SharePoint read for Agent 1.

SET_OperationMode.description: Applies the resolved CurrentOperationMode configuration value to the OperationMode variable, defaulting to PROD_NODMP when no matching configuration row was found.

FILTER_Config_Row_CurrentOperationMode.description: Finds the single configuration row whose Title identifies it as the CurrentOperationMode entry.

Select_ConfigEntries.description: Maps each configuration row to a mode-resolved JSON key-value fragment, replacing the slow per-row loop with a single non-looping data operation.

CMP_ConfigJsonText.description: Completes the configuration JSON text by wrapping all resolved property fragments in braces.

CMP_ConfigObject.description: Converts the generated configuration JSON text into the central Agent 1 runtime configuration object.
